resources.string: REA Image Studio is a professional image editor for Android: layers and groups, masks, selections, brushes, adjustments and filters, with full PSD/PSB support.\n\nIt is built on the open-source PhotoCraft engine (storytold/photocraft) and the PhotoDroid Android shell (Idea-atmosphere/PhotoDroid), both MIT OR Apache-2.0. Their notices are kept in NOTICE, LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE and ATTRIBUTION.md.
Thank you to the PhotoCraft and PhotoDroid authors.
